slot_source: Every {slot} is a key in the AlertEvent.facts{} block, rendered verbatim. The composer must not introduce a number that is not a slot.
ai_rephrase_doctrine: When the user's Account AI mode is ON, the composer may rephrase headline+detail into warmer prose, but: (1) only using the same facts, (2) staying within the char limits, (3) never adding a recommendation. Deterministic render is always the fallback.

strong_setup.headline: {ticker} strong setup - score {score} (+{score_delta})
strong_setup.ai_rephrase: Flag a fresh momentum-recovery setup forming on {ticker}; cite the score and what's confirming it.

score_jump.headline: {ticker} momentum building - score {score} (+{score_delta})
score_jump.ai_rephrase: Note {ticker}'s score climbed meaningfully this hour; cite old→new.

watchlist_upgrade.headline: {ticker} entered watchlist setup - score {score}
watchlist_upgrade.ai_rephrase: Say {ticker} is approaching the zone you flagged; cite distance to target.

price_alert.headline: {ticker} hit your {pct} alert - now {price}
price_alert.ai_rephrase: Tell them {ticker} crossed the {pct} level they armed; cite current price.

portfolio_risk.headline: {ticker} risk: {risk_state} - {pl_pct} P/L
portfolio_risk.ai_rephrase: Surface that a holding ({ticker}) moved into a risk state worth reviewing; cite P/L.

signal_invalidated.headline: {ticker} setup invalidated - score {score} ({score_delta})
signal_invalidated.ai_rephrase: Tell them the {ticker} setup broke down; cite the score drop. No recommendation.

digest.summary: {strong_count} strong setup{strong_s}, {risk_count} risk flag{risk_s}, {near_count} near trigger. Strongest: {top_ticker} {top_score}.
digest.ai_rephrase: A calm 1-2 line read of the hour across the user's book: lead with what changed, name the strongest, keep it scannable. Same numbers only.
